description: Operate a Masheev workspace from the terminal with the masheev CLI. Use when asked to log in to Masheev from a shell, script inbox or contact tasks, get JSON output for automation, reply to a customer from the command line, run Masheev as a local MCP server (masheev mcp serve), or install the Masheev MCP server into Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw or Hermes (masheev mcp install).
